violations.aide: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color

noeuds.resume:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.06:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #2f6b16, surrounding text: #4f5e4f)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text

incomplets.aide: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
